startup_description: Octopart is a vertical search engine enabling users to discover compare prices and view the specifications of electronic components.
Buxfer is online money management software for personal finance account aggregation budgeting bill reminders and forecasting.
OwnLocal is a digital ad agency that transforms print ads into search engine-optimized web ads.
Verbling is a platform for language learners to enhance their language fluency using video chat technology.
CrowdMed provides prediction market technology using the collective intelligence of 'medical detectives' to produce diagnostic suggestions.
Taskforce is a powerful tool that lets you and your team manage your work flow better. You'll be able to reduce emails, collaborate with your colleagues, and get work done without leaving your inbox.
Adioso is a travel search and booking app that allows users to get information on destinations deals planning and booking their trips.
Heap is a web and iOS analytics application that captures and measures every user action in the user's web app.
Apptimize is a technology enabling users to A/B test their native applications on Android and iOS platforms.
Ark.com is a search engine enabling users to search for old classmates new business contacts and friends.
